placement: Linux Xeon 8573C local CPU only, cgroup quota four CPUs, four ordinary engine slots, context 512. Two controlled background processes pin individually to cpu1 and cpu2 during occupied blocks. Same complete original workload and cache reset for each compared arm. No production profile writes.
start_condition: Only start after two quiet 2s cgroup CPU observation intervals below 0.20 CPU and no concurrent local certification or transfer. Single isolated script with 75s wall clock bound. One acquisition, no retry to improve an observed score.
unit: One complete four-client wave through normal host/tokenizer, native prefill and decode, and output callback. Three output tokens per client. Compare all answer IDs, stop reasons and original correctness. Prompt families, seeds and entire paired groups are disjoint across training and holdout.
accounting: All wave prices include real thread changes, CPU load/model inference and visible work. Record native thread counts, CPU affinity, independent foreign process CPU seconds, cgroup wall, graph/cache settings and process overheads. Charge the entire training phase in the first horizon. No assumed future restarts or requests.
measured_selector: Freeze the best complete thread profile in each training regime by median over the two correctly completed paired waves with verified regime (tie favors four, then larger). Choose by the existing affinity-Pilot load reading at arrival, never by labelled process count. Ambiguous readings fall back to the single fastest pooled fixed policy on training. Fewer than two valid training observations per action/regime cause fixed-four fallback; still retain all evidence.
regimes: Quiet requires foreign <=0.5 at arrival, occupied >=1.25 and verified two busy children with aggregate CPU/wall >=1.2 over a quiescent pre-wave interval. Between thresholds counts as uncertain. The original shipped Pilot retains its regular per-step decisions.
gate: All output/stop hashes equal, all verified correct, actual native static profiles match. Same phase/cgroup/machine/control binding. A descriptive load-dependent advantage requires distinct frozen choices, complete valid paired holdout regime groups, and at least 2% lower total wave time than each static alternative including four threads, no larger pooled p95 TTFT and lower time in both independent holdout seeds. First-horizon net must also recover measured spend to claim economic gain. Never activates models or code.
